items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I read an article by a man called, his name was Jean Paul Sartre... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Lawn Party said, well, uh, gonna have a bone dance.

ctx.x: you know? It was all being the jungle's island. And that's where the Taggart was originated from, from the Afrikas in the jungle.

Yeah, I read an article by a man called, his name was Jean Paul Sartre, and he wrote that up. I forgot what paper it is, I have it written down. It's cool. Anyway, he wrote that thing up, you know? Yeah. And they were making the film there. Yeah. And, uh, oh let's see, there's so many guys I want to ask you about. What was the Lawn Party like back in those days?

Oh, Lawn Party said, well, uh, gonna have a bone dance. Uh, the girls buy a gingham. Uh, you got shirts, you see, like it is now, uh, blue gingham. Uh, and some black and white. Uh, and they wore knickerbockers.
